final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading each entry and filtering only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted the timestamps to UTC in ISO 8601 format with a 'Z' suffix. I extracted the message from the first line after the last ' | ' separator. I calculated the repeat_count by adding 1 plus any repeats indicated by subsequent '-- last message repeated N times --' lines. I aggregated the counts_by_service by summing the repeat_count for each service. The results were saved in workspace/errors.json following the required structure and Acme log-triage conventions.
